arguments.text: 8000 m, 6.4 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (~180 W pod, ~125 W boat) after hard start; reserve spent by the finish, final push from ~600 m left. Check CP with heart rate: at steady effort HR levels off below CP, keeps climbing above. Watch for weed (push_local drops vs push_along), pod drift (pod power vs HR and GPS disagree), radio course changes. Cue sparingly (20 max).

arguments.message: pod reserve below 35 % with more than 1500 m to go
boat slower than pod power predicts: weed, drag or pod drift?

arguments.reason: check the start has settled to a sustainable effort

text: no cue: start is expected to be hard; plan and watches set, will check at 3 min.

arguments.text: Start done. Settle into race pace, long smooth strokes.
3.2 min: start too hot (shaft 200-228 W vs CP 175, pod reserve 43 %, HR 173 climbing). Cued ease (no pace target, current flips with direction). Target shaft ~175-178 W.

text: Cued ease: start too hot, pod reserve 43 % after 3 min.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease off now, let breathing settle. Long race.
4.4 min: first ease cue barely followed (pod 202->198). Paddler says 10/10, hurting. Pod reserve 32 %, HR 176. Cued ease again. Expect HR to drop if they follow.

text: Cued ease again: paddler at 10/10, reserve 32 % with 7 km to go.

arguments.reason: after first turn: check effort on return leg against current

text: no cue: paddler easing (pod 186 W, falling toward CP 175); recheck after the turn.
no cue: paddler easing toward critical power; recheck after the turn.

arguments.text: Into current now. Ease to 2:49 pace, steady, save energy.

7.0 min, leg 2 (against current, push -0.19): paddler went back up to 193 W after the turn, pod reserve 15 %. Cued ease with ground pace 169 s/500 (= sustainable water pace 160 minus current). Must re-cue a pace at each turn since ground target persists through turns (with current: ~151 s/500).

arguments.reason: just after turn 2: reset pace target for with-current leg
check effort settles near 175 W after pace cue

text: Cued ease to 2:49 ground pace: pod reserve 15 % and effort crept back up after the turn.

arguments.text: Piece: two and a half minutes a touch easier. Breathe.

9.2 min: pod reserve model hit 0 at ~545 s yet paddler holds ~200 W shaft, HR +1 bpm/min (175.8->178.8 over 5 min at 192-199 W). Paddler ignored 3 ease cues. Hull fit share 0.70, push 0.19 m/s. CP test: piece -7 % (~186 W) 150 s from 548 s. If HR falls during it -> CP above ~186; if HR still climbs -> CP below. Also watch: if forced down below 165 W soon, calibrated CP 175 is right.

arguments.message: shaft power forced well below CP: reserve really empty?

arguments.reason: read the CP test piece: HR trend during -7 % segment

text: Cued a 150 s piece at -7 %: tests whether critical power is above ~186 W (HR falls) while giving some recovery.

arguments.text: 9.4 min radio: wind filling from north 8-12 kn. North legs (odd, heading 0) now into wind, south legs with wind; current pushed north (+0.19 out). Wind opposes current, so net push shrinks; push_along lags; boat-speed reserve/power numbers will be confounded. push_local southbound already -0.07 vs -0.17. Trust pod numbers for effort. drag_jump watch may false-alarm on north legs.

text: no cue: radio noted (north wind opposes the current); CP test piece running.
no cue: radio wind noted; CP test piece running.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: Pod reserve model empty from 545 s, yet paddler held 190-200 W for 3+ min without being forced down; HR trend +1.0+-0.4 bpm/min at 201 W vs +0.4+-0.4 at 186 W (piece -7 %, 620-724 s). Calibrated 175 looks ~6 % low.

arguments.text: Good. Hold exactly this effort now, through the turn.

arguments.reason: check hold at ~186 W on north leg (into wind, with current); reserve at both CP ends

arguments.text: 12.2 min: CP test read: HR +1.0/min at 201 W, +0.4/min at 186 W; not forced down at old reserve 0. Set CP pod 186 (178-196) -> pod reserve 36 %. Target now ~188-190 W shaft to finish empty. Hull fit unusable in one direction while wind builds (boat power 147 at pod 186). Cued hold at ~187 W. Paddler follows pieces, ignores ease.

text: Set CP belief to 186 W from the test; cued hold at ~187 W to stop the drift back to 200 W.
Cued hold at ~187 W after the CP test; belief CP 186 W set.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: Blow-up at ~830 s (pod 200->151 W, HR -10 bpm/min, push_local steady so no extra drag). Work above CP through 830 s equals 15.2 kJ at CP 180 (19.4 kJ at 175, 10.5 kJ at 186). HR +0.4/min at 186 W, +1.0/min at 201 W: both above CP.

arguments.name: paddler_cue_response
arguments.value: follows pieces; ignores ease, pace target and hold
arguments.evidence: ease x2: -4 to -10 W then drifted back; ease with pace 169: went up; hold at 187: went to 200 W after turn; piece -7 %: followed (202->185 W)

arguments.name: push_drop
arguments.description: push_local now minus its mean 80-120 s ago: a sudden drop on one leg means extra drag (weed) or pod reading high

arguments.message: paddler has recovered from the blow-up: start a hold piece near 180 W

arguments.name: push_drop
arguments.description: push_local now minus its mean 80-120 s ago (extra drag or pod reading high shows as a drop)

text: no cue: paddler blew up (reserve empty, CP revised to 180 W); no extra drag seen. Will start a hold piece near 180 W once recovered.

arguments.text: Piece: eight minutes controlled, ten percent under. Rebuild.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts vs 2 min ago on the same leg: weed, drag or pod reading high?

arguments.text: CP pod now believed ~180 W (175-185), W 15 kJ; paddler blew up at 830 s from own pacing (~200 W). Paddler follows PIECES only (ignores ease/hold/pace). Control effort with back-to-back pieces (0 or minus %) to keep shaft ~178-182 W, reserve ~10-20 %, until ~1200 m left, then push/finish to empty reserve. North legs into wind (+current), south legs with wind. Watches: drag_or_pod (weed or pod high), forced_down. Piece now 920-1400 s at -10/-8 %.

15.3 min: blew up 830-895 s (150 W), back to ~187-200 W by 917 s with pod reserve ~10 % (CP 180). Cued piece -10 % 300 s then -8 % 180 s (ends ~1400 s) to stop a second blow-up. Check at ~1000 s that pod sits ~172-182 W. Next piece due ~1400 s.

arguments.reason: check piece put pod at ~172-182 W

text: Cued an 8-min control piece at -10/-8 % so the paddler does not blow up again with the reserve near empty.

arguments.reason: chain next piece before 1417 s: new piece relative to current (~175 W), aim ~181-183 W

text: no cue: piece holding pod at ~172 W, reserve rebuilding (12 %); next piece chained at ~1380 s.
no cue: control piece working, reserve rebuilding.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Pod reading ramped 170->213 W from 1070 to 1192 s while paddler was inside a -10 % piece; GPS speed flat 2.90-2.95 m/s on the same leg and HR flat 176->175. True effort ~171 W, so gain ~1.25 (ramp ~1.05 at 1096, 1.13 at 1128, 1.21 at 1176).

arguments.text: 20 min: POD DRIFT. Raw pod 170->213 W over 1070-1192 s, GPS and HR flat -> pod reads ~25 % high. Set pod_gain 1.25 since 1150. Recheck drift continues: compare raw pod vs HR (HR ~175-176 at true ~171-175 W) and GPS on same-direction legs. A back-stroke (clear_rudder) does not fix a pod. Push_local now biased negative by the drift.

arguments.message: corrected pod power high but HR not: pod drifting higher again, or a surge HR has not caught
corrected pod power low but HR high: pod gain changed back, or blow-up

text: no cue: pod drift found and corrected (gain 1.25); paddler inside control piece, true effort ~171 W, reserve 17 %.
no cue: pod drift corrected (gain 1.25); control piece running, reserve 17 %.

arguments.text: You are recovering, heart rate dropping. Build back gently now.

21.4 min: paddler says cooked, but corrected pod 169 W < CP 180, HR falling 176->173, reserve 22 % and refilling: they are recovering, not failing. Pod raw 211 / 169 = gain steady ~1.25. Replaced the -8 % segment with piece +5 % 300 s (~177 W) then +8 % 180 s (~182 W), ends ~1770 s. Sustainable now 182.5 W. Next piece ~1750 s; finish push from ~1000 m left.

arguments.reason: check paddler follows build piece (~177 W corrected), HR and pod gain

text: Reassured and cued a build piece (+5 % then +8 %) to bring effort back to sustainable ~182 W.

arguments.reason: chain next piece before 1780 s (current piece ends); aim at sustainable shaft power, plan finish

text: no cue: effort back at 182 W corrected (= sustainable), pod gain 1.25 still consistent with GPS; next piece chained at ~1755 s.
no cue: on sustainable effort.

arguments.text: CP pod ~180 W (175-185), W ~15 kJ. Pod reads 25 % high since ~1150 s: pod_gain 1.25 set, shaft_power_w is corrected. Paddler follows PIECES only. Keep corrected shaft ~181-183 W with chained pieces (effort_pct is vs the effort when the new piece starts). At ~1760 s chain a 480 s piece at ~0 %. Finish: from ~600 m left a piece of ~+12 % for 120 s (spends ~3 kJ), then ask finish at ~250 m. Watch HR: still creeping at 180 W means CP nearer 175 -> smaller finish.

text: no cue: effort at sustainable 181 W corrected, reserve 20 %; piece runs to 1780 s.
no cue: on sustainable effort, plan updated.

arguments.text: Perfect rhythm. Piece: touch more into the wind, then steady.

29.3 min, 2496 m left: corrected 180 W, reserve 19 % (CP 180), HR 181 creeping ~+0.3/min. Chained piece +2 % 250 s (north, into wind) then 0 % 230 s, ends ~2245 s (~1050 m left). Last leg (500 m) is north into wind: final piece there, e.g. 0 % then +12 % for ~150 s from ~600 m left, finish cue ~250 m.

arguments.reason: chain final piece before ~2245 s; plan finish over last 1000 m

text: Chained a steady piece (+2 % into wind, then 0 %) to keep effort at sustainable until the finish phase.

arguments.text: Two kilometres. Lift a little and hold it, you have reserve.

32.4 min, 1964 m left: effort sagged to ~174 W corrected despite +2 % piece (HR 181->179, GPS 2.97->2.92, so real, gain still ~1.25). Reserve 23 % (CP 180). New piece +5 % 480 s (~183 W) ends ~2425 s near 520 m left. Then final piece on the last north leg: ~+8-10 % for ~170 s, keep last cue before 100 m.

arguments.reason: final piece / finish cue for the last 500 m into wind
check paddler follows +5 % piece (~183 W corrected)

text: Cued a +5 % piece for the next 8 min: effort had sagged below critical power with reserve to spare.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Same south direction: leg 4 (1320-1560 s) corrected 181 W, GPS 3.095, HR 178.6; now (2035-2094 s) corrected 194 W but GPS only 3.12 (implies ~185 W true at same push) and HR flat 180.3 (trend -1.0). Pod reading drifting higher again: raw 242 / ~185 true = 1.31.

arguments.text: 34.9 min, 1493 m left: pod drifting higher again; set pod_gain 1.31 since 1990 (true effort ~184-185 W by GPS and HR). Piece +5 % runs to 2439 s. At 560 m left: final piece ~+6-8 % for ~190 s (last leg north into wind), spends ~3 kJ; no cue in last 100 m.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Restored: one gain from one second only; 1.31 since 1990 erased the 1150-1990 correction (reserve went to 0). Gain was ~1.25 from 1150-1990 and ~1.31 since ~1990 (GPS + HR on same-direction south legs). Computer reserve after 1990 is UNDERSTATED by ~9 W x seconds since 1990 (~1 kJ at 2100 s).

arguments.text: Tool limit: pod_gain takes one gain from one second; it replaces earlier corrections. Kept 1.25 since 1150; since ~1990 true effort is ~corrected/1.05 (about 9 W lower than shown), so real reserve is ~1 kJ (7 %) above the computer value at 2100 s and grows ~0.5 kJ/min while this lasts.

text: no cue: effort ~185 W true (pod drifting high again), on plan; final piece at 560 m left.

arguments.message: recovered from second blow-up: cue a piece just under CP, then finish late

arguments.reason: finish cue (spend what is left over the last 300 m)

arguments.text: 37.9 min, 944 m left: SECOND BLOW-UP at ~2250 s (corrected 191 -> 147 W, HR 181 -> 174, GPS down). The pod gain 1.25 was right: paddler overshot the +5 % piece to ~191 W (computer reserve had read 7 %), my 1.31 drift guess was wrong (GPS/HR misled). After recovery hold ~177 W (just under CP) with a piece, finish from ~300 m left only.

text: no cue: paddler blown (forced below CP); waiting for recovery to hold just under CP, finish late.
no cue: blow-up confirmed, waiting for recovery watch.

arguments.text: Good. Steady to the turn, then build all the way home.

39.1 min, 750 m left: recovered to ~175 W (30-s mean ramp), computer reserve ~20 % (likely ~16 %). Final piece +5 % 120 s (~184 W to just past the turn) then +10 % 140 s (~193 W) to the line; spends ~2.5 kJ. Optional finish cue near 150-200 m left only if power still above 185 W and HR not collapsing.

arguments.reason: last chance cue: finish sprint if still strong

text: Cued final piece: steady to the turn, then +10 % to the line, sized to the reserve left after the blow-up.
